author: Russell Brand
description:
Everyone has an opinion on the Austin Metcalf case and Russell Brand says that is exactly the point. The rage, the outrage, the demands for justice — Russell argues that all of it reveals something uncomfortable about who we actually are and what we actually believe. Because if you believe in justice you have to at least consider forgiveness. Not for Karmelo Anthony's sake. For yours. Without forgiveness nothing ever ends and you live in the pain forever. Russell makes the case that nobody else in this debate is willing to make.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand makes the argument that what we are seeing in Germany, the UK and Ireland is not an accident. Migration programs that are producing this level of domestic disruption do not fail by coincidence. Russell points to Ireland as the clearest example — a country that was colonized and oppressed by Britain, that cannot be accused of imperial guilt, that is now being called racist for raising the same questions as everyone else. When the same script gets used on every country regardless of its history, Russell says that tells you everything about who is running the script.

author: Russell Brand
description:
In this clip Russell Brand asked the question nobody in power wanted answered — why would any government refuse a rape gang inquiry unless they already knew what it would find. Today MP Rupert Lowe published the findings after an 18-month investigation and the answer is as damning as Russell predicted. Over 250,000 girls were raped, tortured and abused across the United Kingdom over decades. Politicians knew. Police knew. Social services knew. And they buried it. Russell saw this coming. The question now is what happens next.
